description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests to set WAN interface configurations and trigger device reboot on a web management interface. It retrieves POST data, updates device settings via getStr/setStr functions, and outputs a JSON response.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves configuration string values based on a given path.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets configuration string values at specified paths, optionally with a commit flag.
